phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F6 Phase B — Bilateral Component Coverage Audit
scientific_interpretation: None of the tested F6 subcomponents is published bilaterally in the W2/W1 layer for the RMD sector mapping, including F62 and F63 even though those instruments are published at aggregate level.
The Phase A aggregate F62/F63 observations therefore do not translate into holder-by-issuer component equations.
Neither the full six-component identity nor the transmission-block identity reconstructs any bilateral F6 cell.
With no direct total-F6 cells and no bilateral component cells, the remaining public evidence consists of resident W0 holder/issuer total-F6 controls and total-economy W1 total-F6 controls.
No issuer-applicability zero has been introduced; any such future structural rule would require a separate instrument-specific gate.

rank_preview.known_dependency: sum(resident holder W0 totals)-W1 assets = sum(resident issuer W0 totals)-W1 liabilities
rank_preview.note: This is a preview only; the next gate computes exact rational rank/nullspace and source RHS consistency.

next_gate.name: F6 Phase C — exact aggregate-control rank/nullspace audit
required_checks: compute exact rational rank/nullity over 35 in-boundary F6 variables using all published W0/W1 total-F6 equations
verify the domestic asset/liability accounting RHS identity within published precision
identify any unconditional rank-unique bilateral F6 coordinates
introduce no issuer-applicability or non-negativity structural zero in the unconditional system
if zero useful unique cells result, freeze F6 at the aggregate-only public-data boundary and advance to F7
